Spring 2024
​the late hour
Life tells us to rush through the boring and avoid the inevitable. But what happens when the night, a performance, must end? At the core of our spring 2024 show, we aim to visualize this struggle against time and limits, something that drives us to chase a goal. 

Made possible through a Spring 2024 Student-Led Dance Group Residency.

In residence at the Dance Center from April 14 to 20th.
​Directed by Jane Roe '25 and Mara Quill '25.
